description: This file defines the ProcessInfo class and related classes for managing and querying process information within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes process enumeration, priority, policy, memory usage, and process control functionalities, as well as process tree management.

classes.name: ProcessInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a process, including its ID, priority, policy, memory usage, and methods to control or query the process.

classes.name: ProcessCurrent
classes.description: Derived from ProcessInfo, provides additional methods to get the current process's user and group information.

classes.name: ProcessTree
classes.description: Represents a tree of processes, allowing to analyze process hierarchies and occupancy.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Nested within ProcessInfo, used to iterate over processes, child processes, or processes matching certain criteria.

methods.name: ProcessInfo()
methods.description: Default constructor for ProcessInfo, initializes process information for the current process or an invalid state.

methods.name: ProcessInfo(const process_t id)
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ProcessInfo with a specific process ID.

methods.name: Id()
methods.description: Returns the process ID.

methods.name: Children()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the child processes.

methods.name: Priority()
methods.description: Gets the process priority.

methods.name: Priority(const int8_t priority)
methods.description: Sets the process priority.

methods.name: Policy()
methods.description: Gets the scheduling policy.

methods.name: Policy(const scheduler priority)
methods.description: Sets the scheduling policy.

methods.name: OOMAdjust()
methods.description: Gets the Out-Of-Memory adjustment value.

methods.name: OOMAdjust(const int8_t adjust)
methods.description: Sets the Out-Of-Memory adjustment value.

methods.name: IsActive()
methods.description: Checks if the process is active.

methods.name: Kill(const bool hardKill)
methods.description: Terminates the process, optionally with a hard kill.

methods.name: Allocated()
methods.description: Returns the amount of allocated memory.

methods.name: Resident()
methods.description: Returns the resident memory size.

methods.name: Shared()
methods.description: Returns the shared memory size.

methods.name: Jiffies()
methods.description: Returns the process jiffies (CPU time).

methods.name: Name()
methods.description: Returns the process name.

methods.name: Executable()
methods.description: Returns the executable path.

methods.name: CommandLine()
methods.description: Returns the command line arguments.

methods.name: MarkOccupiedPages(uint32_t bitSet[], const uint32_t size)
methods.description: Marks occupied pages in memory.

methods.name: FindByName(const string& name, const bool exact, std::list<ProcessInfo>& processInfos)
methods.description: Finds processes by name.

methods.name: FindChildrenWithName(uint32_t parentPid, std::map<string, uint32_t>& pidwithName)
methods.description: Finds child processes with a specific parent PID and name.

methods.name: ProcessCurrent()
methods.description: Constructor for ProcessCurrent, representing the current process.

methods.name: User()
methods.description: Returns the user name of the current process.

methods.name: User(const string& userName)
methods.description: Sets the user for the current process.

methods.name: Group()
methods.description: Returns the group name of the current process.

methods.name: Group(const string& groupName)
methods.description: Sets the group for the current process.

methods.name: ProcessTree(const ProcessInfo& processInfo)
methods.description: Constructor to create a process tree starting from a specific process.

methods.name: MarkOccupiedPages(uint32_t bitSet[], const uint32_t size) const
methods.description: Marks occupied pages in the process tree.

methods.name: ContainsProcess(ThreadId pid) const
methods.description: Checks if a process with the given thread ID exists in the tree.

methods.name: GetProcessIds(std::list<ThreadId>& processIds) const
methods.description: Retrieves all process IDs in the tree.

methods.name: RootId()
methods.description: Returns the root process ID of the tree.

methods.name: Jiffies()
methods.description: Returns total CPU time for the process tree.
